rules.title: Emigrant transfers described as staged
rules.official: 汇发[2014]2号 §VI abolished staged remittance; one or several remittances are allowed.

rules.title: Foreign tax credit called “dollar-for-dollar”
rules.official: Credit only for foreign income tax actually owed (after treaty); none on FEIE-excluded income.

rules.title: 2027 foreign earned income exclusion
rules.official: USD 137,300 for tax years beginning in 2027 (Rev. Proc. 2026-35 §3.41).

rules.title: HSBC CNY 620 wire-fee cap in USD
rules.official: Cap CNY 500 + cable CNY 120 = CNY 620; at HSBC's 2026-11-10 sell rate 6.7053746 that is USD 92.46.

rules.title: Crypto / stablecoin routes
rules.official: 银发〔2026〕42号: all virtual-currency business, stablecoins included, is illegal financial activity.

rules.title: FBAR non-wilful penalty amount
rules.official: 31 CFR 1010.821: non-wilful maximum USD 16,536; wilful USD 165,353.

rules.title: USD 50,000 annual figure applied to a foreigner
rules.official: Art. 2 sets USD 50,000 each for domestic individuals' settlement and purchase; Art. 13 lets foreigners buy FX for lawful income with ID and income/tax proof.
